entries.o: The Dark Elves' bow attacks target the\nback row. They're physical attacks, so\ndon't put anyone with low STR in the back.
The enemies' attacks aren't centralized,\nbut they have high AGL, so finish\nthem off quickly with multiple-hit moves.
The White Wyrm's Max move, Gale Wing,\nblows you out of battle, so avoid\nusing multiple-hit skills!
They are a powerful team, but the\nGriffons in the front have simple attack\npatterns.
The Belial Queen attacks distant targets\nwith dark moves. Make sure nobody in\nthe back row is weak to dark!
The Siren's Lullaby causes you to fall\nasleep. On top of that, it's unblockable,\nso be careful.
The Talos attacks the front line with\na move that lowers HP by percentage,\nso heal them often.
Watch out for the Cerberus's Max move,\nBullet Dive, as it forces your front and\nback lines to switch places.
He attacks with powerful fire moves.\nAttack with ice while increasing your\nfire resistance.
The two L. Elementals are the main\nconcern. Characters with low MGC or\na corresponding weakness, beware!
The Bahamut is persistent, but remember\nthe Valkyrie in the back. She has low STR,\nso physical attacks are effective.
She attacks with powerful ice skills.\nAttack with fire, while increasing your\nresistance to ice.
The Lich summons an undead enemy\nwith high HP. Try to defeat the Lich\nbefore it has a chance to summon.
The Simurgh can cause various ailments\nsuch as STONE and FREEZE, so stay alert\nand come prepared.
The Obinick's Max move, Air Assault,\ntargets randomly and has low accuracy,\nbut it's powerful when it connects.
The Tyrants have powerful attacks and\nDiana's Vassal will try to finish\nyou off, so be careful.
It's best to use property magic\non the Titan. It has high VIT,\nso use appropriate techniques.
Her ice attacks are incredibly powerful.\nIce and holy won't scathe her, so\nplan around her only weakness: fire.
It has high MGC, so use physical attacks\nrather than magic. The enemy is flying,\nso try an anti-air move...
She has high MGC and an ultra-powerful\nlightning attack, so watch those with\nlow MGC or low lightning resistance.
He has high STR and high physical\nresistance, so use magic with other\nproperties. He guards sometimes, too.
Dark Death's Max move, Onslaught of\nDoom, can absorb HP. Keep dealing\ndamage with holy-property attacks.
Utilize the fact that it's a flying\ndragon to deal damage efficiently.\nIt's also weak against lightning.
Hector uses Element Transition to change\nhis property. If you attack with the wrong\nproperty, he'll regain HP!
Seth-Rah uses Metamorphosis to change\nher abilities. Her weakness changes as\nwell, so keep your attacks varied.
The Hell Curser uses physical attacks,\nbut the back row uses magic. Keep an eye\non each character's stats.
The Tiamat has high STR and VIT,\nso physical attacks do little damage.\nTry using holy or ice magic.
Watch out for the two Geist. Their\nMax move, Explosion, is powerful, so\ndon't let them use it.
The Bomber Kid is susceptible to SLEEP\nailments, so bringing a Slumber Ivy along\nmay be a good idea.
The Bomber Kid's Max move, Atomic Bomb,\nis powerful, lowering everyone's HP by\nabout 2/3, so be careful!
The Bomber Kid is susceptible to SLEEP\nailments, so bringing a Slumber Ivy along\nmay be useful.
Wielder of incredible power. Find his\nweakness and continue attacking with\nthat property while healing often.
Both are weak against fire attacks.\nThe Griffon is a mid-air enemy, so\nchose your skills carefully.
Be careful of the Max skill Atomic\nBomb! Something good might happen if\nyou keep the bomb after battle...
You will need Trigger Points to\nprogress ahead. Aim for a high\nrank and earn lots of TP.
The slightest miss can spell\ndisaster. Take your time and\nattack with caution.
The Salamander only changes\nproperties at Rage, so you could\ntry keeping the Rage meter low.
Avoid physical attacks and use\nmagic. You can earn a lot of\npoints by defeating it.
Cerberus is quick, making a high\nrank difficult. Defeat it quickly\nwith fire attacks.
They use their bows to attack from\na distance, so pay attention to\nwho is in the back.
It has low HP, but it's worth a\nlot of points. Use fire attacks\nand try and get an S rank.
Holy attacks are extremely\neffective. Plenty of items await\nyou after battle.
Physical attacks are very useful\nagainst the Basilisk, which has\nhigh VIT, so be careful.
This opponent shouldn't be much\nof a problem. Fire attacks are\neffective.
The best item may not always be\nthe S rank item.
The Valkyries have high MGC but\nlow STR, so physical attacks are\nthe way to go.
With an iron defense, this\nopponent is hard to defeat.\nJust keep at it.
An easy battle considering the\nenemy's low attack power.\nFire attacks are useful here.
The enemy's MAX move, Earthquake,\nis powerful, so it's best to\ndefeat it before it can use it.
It will be a long battle with\nLindwurm's high HP. Make use of\nits weakness, lightning.
All 3 are tough against physical\nattacks. Lightning attacks are\neffective on all 3 of them.
There should have been a useful\nitem on the way here...
It may be best not to waste items\non weak enemies.
Your items' durability will\ndecrease, so don't bring important\nitems into this battle.
Physical attacks are effective,\nbut be sure to bring recovery\nitems, just in case.
Death and the Belial Queen are\nboth weak against Holy attacks,\nso use them to deal damage.
Attack the Golem with Lightning,\nand the Hell Curser with Holy.
Get an S rank and it'll drop a\nGran Sabre. Be aggressive so you\ncan restock on items.
<fe><02><09><64><30><30><5f><30><30><30><34><00>To actuate the Retribution\nand judge the demons...
<fe><02><09><64><30><31><5f><30><30><30><33><00>Isn't there a way to save\nboth Asgard and Riviera?
<fe><02><09><64><30><31><5f><30><30><30><34><00>That is not necessary.\nWe need only follow orders.
<fe><02><09><64><30><32><5f><30><30><30><33><00>Well, I was in the forest,\nand you fell from the sky.
<fe><02><09><64><30><35><5f><30><30><30><35><00>I was looking for ingredients.\nWhat about you?
Thanks for choosing me.\nI'll do my best.
Woo! You rock!\nI'll do my best.
You chose Lina!\nI'll do my best.
Thank you for choosing me.\nI'll do my best.
<fe><02><09><64><34><31><5f><30><30><30><33><00>Thank you, Ein, from\nthe bottom of my heart.
<fe><02><09><64><34><31><5f><30><30><31><30><00>It all started when you\nwere picked up off the road...
<fe><02><09><64><34><31><5f><30><30><31><38><00>I may just have to raise\nmy opinion of you... a little.
<fe><02><09><64><34><31><5f><30><30><32><35><00>Now, tell me everything\nyou saw on your quest.
<fe><02><09><64><34><31><5f><30><30><32><36><00>With the demons gone, I can\nnow focus on my experiments.
<fe><02><09><64><34><31><5f><30><30><32><37><00>Now I can go outside to\nfind ingredients<a2><52>
<fe><02><09><64><34><31><5f><30><30><32><38><00>In that case, go fetch me\nthree dried bats!
<fe><02><09><64><34><31><5f><30><30><33><36><00>This is it: a cake of\nElendia's best fruits.
<fe><02><09><64><34><31><5f><30><30><35><33><00>Stop talking until we\nput the fire out...<fe><00><fe><02><09><64><34><31><5f><30><30><35><34><00>The whole house is\ngoing to burn down!
<fe><02><09><64><32><32><5f><30><30><31><30><00>Ancient spirits who bind Riviera\ntogether, protect our land...
<fe><02><09><64><32><32><5f><30><30><31><37><00>I just pray that\nthis peace will last.
<fe><02><09><64><32><32><5f><30><30><31><38><00>It will, as long as\nwe keep trying hard.
<fe><02><09><64><32><32><5f><30><30><32><35><00>I bet I could use it\nto develop new spells.
<fe><02><09><64><32><32><5f><30><30><34><32><00>Now the nearby towns\ncan live in peace.
<fe><02><09><64><32><32><5f><30><30><35><32><00>Are you done cleaning yet?\nLet's take five.
<fe><02><09><64><32><32><5f><30><30><35><35><00>Cierra gave it to me\nwhen we left.<fe><00><fe><02><09><64><32><32><5f><30><30><35><36><00>It's a magical perfume\nthat grants a single wish.
<fe><02><09><64><32><32><5f><30><30><37><38><00>Ein, there's been another\ndemon sighting in Riviera.
<fe><02><09><64><32><32><5f><30><30><38><30><00>Ein, it's okay. Let\nthe Sprites handle it.
<fe><02><09><64><32><32><5f><30><30><38><32><00>Now, hurry it up!\nYour report's due today.
<fe><02><09><64><32><32><5f><30><30><38><35><00>Don't worry, Riviera\nis the Sprites' land now.

<fe><02><09><64><32><31><5f><30><30><30><30><00>Thanks to Ein and his friends,
the Accursed were defeated and
Riviera was saved.
          
<fe><02><09><64><32><31><5f><30><30><30><32><00>It is said that Ein never returned
to Asgard, <fe><02><09><64><32><31><5f><30><30><30><33><00>but instead lived out
his days in the Promised Land
with the Sprites...

<fe><02><09><64><32><31><5f><30><30><30><34><00>Thanks to Ein and his friends,
the Accursed were defeated and
Riviera was saved.
          
<fe><02><09><64><32><31><5f><30><30><30><36><00>However, <fe><02><09><64><32><31><5f><30><30><30><37><00>Ein was never seen again...

<fe><02><09><64><32><32><5f><30><30><30><36><00>Ein remained in Riviera, where he
and Lina became treasure hunters,
wandering from ruin to ruin.
                   
<fe><02><09><64><32><32><5f><30><30><30><39><00>Thus began a new adventure...
                   
<fe><02><09><64><32><32><5f><30><30><30><38><00>The unlikely pair would later make
a grand discovery and become known
as the Legendary Treasure Hunters.

<fe><02><09><64><32><32><5f><30><30><32><30><00>Ein remained in Riviera to help
maintain the peace with Fia, who
became a valiant warrior.
                   
<fe><02><09><64><32><32><5f><30><30><32><32><00>Due to their efforts, it is said,
<fe><02><09><64><32><32><5f><30><30><32><33><00>the Sprites of Elendia spent an
eternity in peace.

<fe><02><09><64><32><32><5f><30><30><33><34><00>Ein remained in Riviera and, along
with Cierra, searched the Nelde
Ruins for hidden knowledge.
                   
<fe><02><09><64><32><32><5f><30><30><33><36><00>All the spells used today
in modern Riviera stem from magic
those two discovered...
<fe><02><09><64><32><32><5f><30><30><33><37><00>As recorded in the books...

<fe><02><09><64><32><32><5f><30><30><34><37><00>Ein remained in Riviera and traveled
across the land with Serene to rid
the world of demons.
                   
<fe><02><09><64><32><32><5f><30><30><34><39><00>One day, the pair's unrelenting
10-year battle <fe><02><09><64><32><32><5f><30><30><35><30><00>will be passed down
from generation to generation
in the Annals of Riviera.

<fe><02><09><64><32><32><5f><30><30><37><34><00>Ein was surprised his Familiar
was female (and now human), but they
remained an inseparable team.
                   
<fe><02><09><64><32><32><5f><30><30><37><35><00>They kept busy by recording the entire
account of the great war, fought
by brave Sprites and angels,
<fe><02><09><64><32><32><5f><30><30><37><37><00>all in the pages of Riviera's history...

<fe><02><09><64><32><32><5f><30><30><38><36><00>Afterwards, Ein and Rose returned
to Asgard and created a study facility.
<fe><02><09><64><32><32><5f><30><30><38><38><00>With the Magi's permission, they
sought to discover the truth behind
the Retribution, legacy of the gods.
                   
<fe><02><09><64><32><32><5f><30><30><38><39><00>Asgard has already begun to move
toward a new era...
<fe><02><09><64><32><33><5f><30><30><30><30><00>Thus ends my account of\nthe intertwining histories\nof Asgard and Riviera.
<fe><02><09><64><32><33><5f><30><30><30><31><00>I saw, heard, and experienced\nthe events first-hand...
<fe><02><09><64><32><33><5f><30><30><30><32><00>Fate is not something\nforced onto you, nor is\nit something one yields to.
<fe><02><09><64><32><33><5f><30><30><30><33><00>Fate is something to be\ncarved with one's own hands...
<fe><02><09><64><32><33><5f><30><30><30><34><00>If you believe in yourself,\nyou will break free from all\nthat binds you...
<fe><02><09><64><32><33><5f><30><30><30><35><00>I hope to pass this message\non to as many people as I can...
<fe><02><09><64><32><33><5f><30><30><30><36><00>This is dedicated to a certain angel,\nwho was my dearest friend.

<fe><02><09><64><33><30><5f><30><30><30><30><00>Asgard, realm of the gods...
Utgard, land of the demons...
               
<fe><02><09><64><33><30><5f><30><30><30><31><00>Ragnarok--the war between the gods
and the demon invaders--cast the
world into a state of violent chaos.
               
<fe><02><09><64><33><30><5f><30><30><30><32><00>Overrun by demons, Asgard teetered
on the brink of destruction.

<fe><02><09><64><33><31><5f><30><30><30><30><00>In desperation, the gods broke
the ancient covenant and created
the black-winged Grim Angels.
               
<fe><02><09><64><33><31><5f><30><30><30><31><00>Each armed with a Diviner,
the angels descended to battle...
               
<fe><02><09><64><33><31><5f><30><30><30><32><00>The battle raged on, but through
their valiant efforts, the angels
ended the war.

<fe><02><09><64><33><32><5f><30><30><30><30><00>The demons were sealed away,
but the gods would soon follow.
               
<fe><02><09><64><33><32><5f><30><30><30><31><00>Leaving their power behind in the
heavenly isle of Riviera, the gods
entrusted the land's inhabitants to
watch over it until their return...
               
<fe><02><09><64><33><32><5f><30><30><30><32><00>1000 years passed quietly...

<fe><02><09><64><33><33><5f><30><30><30><30><00>Signs of the demons' return were
rumored throughout Riviera.
               
<fe><02><09><64><33><33><5f><30><30><30><31><00>The Seven Magi, proxies of the gods,
made a decision for the sake
of Asgard's existence...
               
<fe><02><09><64><33><33><5f><30><30><30><32><00>...To activate the divine power
of destruction, ¤The Retribution.¤

<fe><02><09><64><33><34><5f><30><30><30><30><00>The Magi appointed this task
to beings well-suited for the job...
               
<fe><02><09><64><33><34><5f><30><30><30><31><00>Black-winged agents of death,
the Grim Angels...
               
<fe><02><09><64><33><34><5f><30><30><30><32><00>Now, two angels shall descend
upon the sacred soil of Riviera.

<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><61><5f><30><30><30><30><00>Ursula, the mysterious woman
who appeared at Heaven's Gate,
used the Sacred Tongue to summon
the holy beast Aghart.

<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><61><5f><30><30><30><31><00>The Grim Angels succeeded in defeating
Aghart, but in the midst of battle,
Ein disappeared.

<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><61><5f><30><30><30><32><00>Meanwhile, Ledah crossed Heaven's Gate
and finally set foot on Riviera's soil.

<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><62><5f><30><30><30><30><00>Ein awakened in Elendia, a village
in Riviera, only to discover that
his memories were gone.

<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><62><5f><30><30><30><31><00>The Sprites, fearful of
the demons, have done nothing
despite losing contact with the Arcs,
guardians of Lacrima Castle.

<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><62><5f><30><30><30><32><00>Fia and Lina, two Sprites who couldn't
bear to stand by and wait any longer,
used the village's magic circle without
permission to go and investigate Lacrima
Castle, taking Ein with them.

<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><63><5f><30><30><30><30><00>The Arcs have been annihilated.

<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><63><5f><30><30><30><31><00>Serene, the lone survivor,
joined the party.
Ursula, the mysterious woman,
reappeared before them.
Now, Riviera is threatened by both
the Accursed and the demon who hunts
Sprites...

<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><63><5f><30><30><30><32><00>The wheels of fate have begun to turn,
ever so slowly.

<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><64><5f><30><30><30><30><00>The shadow of the Accursed...

<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><64><5f><30><30><30><31><00>Realizing the grave danger,
Ein and company leave Elendia and head
for the ancient ruins of Nelde.

<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><64><5f><30><30><30><32><00>It is rumored that Nelde, an aged place,
is still riddled with magic traps.

<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><64><5f><30><30><30><33><00>Ein, accompanied by Fia, Lina and Serene,
sets foot in Wiese Forest in search of
the entrance to the ruins.
Within the ruins, he hopes to find
the source of their trouble, the Accursed...

<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><65><5f><30><30><30><30><00>Ein encountered the witch Cierra
at Nelde.

<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><65><5f><30><30><30><31><00>With her help, they were able to
navigate through the ruins and
seal away the Accursed.

<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><65><5f><30><30><30><32><00>After sealing away the Accursed,
Ein was reunited with his Familiar,
Rose,

<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><65><5f><30><30><30><33><00>but still lacks the means to
contact Hector or Ledah.

<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><66><5f><30><30><30><30><00>Ein's party departs from Elendia after
learning the whereabouts of another
Accursed. They then journey to
the sunken city of Tetyth.

<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><66><5f><30><30><30><31><00>Legend has it that Tetyth was submerged
because its inhabitants angered the gods.

<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><66><5f><30><30><30><32><00>As a representative of Asgard,
Ein approaches the city with
heavy footsteps and a heavy heart...

<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><68><5f><30><30><30><30><00>A fateful reunion with Ledah
only reminds Ein of his duty
as a Grim Angel.
<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><68><5f><30><30><30><31><00>But things have changed since
their time in Asgard.


<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><68><5f><30><30><30><32><00>As his mind races back and forth,
Ein begins the long journey back
to Elendia.

<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><69><5f><30><30><30><30><00>Ein and company set out for Mireno.

<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><69><5f><30><30><30><31><00>It is rumored that there is a secret
entrance leading deep underground,
where ghouls supposedly lurk.

<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><69><5f><30><30><30><32><00>Ein's party prepares to search
the subterranean cemetery and
seal the Accursed...

<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><6a><5f><30><30><30><30><00>Unraveling the secret of the ankhs,
Ein and company made their way
through Mireno and sealed the last
of the Accursed.


<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><6a><5f><30><30><30><31><00>Finally, all of the Accursed have
been sealed.
Ein, believing that Riviera has been
saved, hurries back to Elendia in
high spirits.

<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><6b><5f><30><30><30><30><00>Ein and his companions journey to
the holy domain of Yggdrasil,
<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><6b><5f><30><30><30><31><00>and in an effort to stop Ledah,
the party steps inside the tree
of light.

<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><6b><5f><30><30><30><32><00>While Ledah aims to actuate
the Retribution, Ein struggles
desperately to prevent it...

<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><6b><5f><30><30><30><33><00>The two angels continue to walk their
own paths, although they seem
to diverge even further...

<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><6c><5f><30><30><30><30><00>Ein witnessed the death of Ledah
and the emergence of a third
Grim Angel, Malice.

<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><6c><5f><30><30><30><31><00>The revival of Ursula's counterpart,
Seth, who holds the key to
the Retribution, was also unveiled...

<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><6c><5f><30><30><30><32><00>With the destruction of
the Aquariums, Yggdrasil is now
vulnerable.

<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><6c><5f><30><30><30><33><00>What will be the fate of those who
can alter Riviera's future...?

<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><6d><5f><30><30><30><30><00>The advent of the Retribution draws near...


<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><6d><5f><30><30><30><31><00>The Maze of Shadows floating in Riviera's
skies is an ominous reminder of
the devastation to come.

<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><6d><5f><30><30><30><32><00>Many powerful forces await Ein:
the Grim Angel, Malice<fc><4a> Hector, one of
the Seven Magi<fc><4a> and the destructive Seth.


<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><6d><5f><30><30><30><33><00>In order to pass judgment on Hector
and protect the future of Riviera,
Ein once again enters Heaven's Gate...

<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><6d><5f><30><30><30><34><00>...where it all began...
From the Maze of Shadows to Elendia...

<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><6e><5f><30><30><30><30><00>Unknown to all lies a realm of chaos
far beneath Riviera: the Underworld.


<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><6e><5f><30><30><30><31><00>The gate that leads there is said
to exist in Parveeju Temple...




<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><6e><5f><30><30><30><32><00>What awaits Ein's party...?
